freeze_scope: Admission gates and candidate order were frozen after preliminary candidate discovery and before final adjudication/new closure calculations.

candidates.system: CO/Cu(001) frustrated translation and microscopic diffusion
passed: independent damping evidence within source-specific regimes
candidates.decisive_reason: No recovered independent damping value is matched closely enough in temperature and coverage to the independent diffusion record; the FT has rotational admixture without a quantitative saddle-path overlap.

failed_gates: G2 scalar license on true reactive carrier
candidates.decisive_reason: Reaction-coordinate friction mapping and basin frequency used by the Kramers analysis are calibrated against the target rate series; CO-stretch T1 is not the reactive-coordinate damping.

candidates.system: IR-driven cis-trans HONO isomerization in solid Kr
candidates.decisive_reason: Pumped OH-stretch population loss contains IVR and reactive transfer, and the reactive architecture migrates into torsional/internal and matrix-cage coordinates.

candidates.system: Photoinduced electron transfer with independently parameterized generalized Langevin dynamics
candidates.decisive_reason: The native friction contains essential memory terms; a single local gamma/(2 omega_L) discards required dynamical state.

closure: No fully independent chi-CapitalChi-barrier-outcome record was found among the frozen candidates. A future positive closure requires new evidence rather than reinterpretation of these sources.
